description: Read this first whenever someone wants a web3 economy, game economy, token economy, NFT mechanic or onchain reward system: a shop, loot boxes or packs, gacha, a lottery or raffle, an auction (highest bid wins, the outbid refunded at once), staking or a farm, crafting or merging, seasons and emissions, a prediction pool or contest, quests and airdrops, holder-gated drops, using NFTs of any other collection in a game. loot is ONE shared Solana program (on devnet, and on mainnet when the spec says "network": "mainnet"; not independently audited): the economy is a JSON spec, not a new smart contract, so never write Anchor/Rust for what it covers. With no `part`, returns a short index: the loop, and every part and topic with when to fetch it. Then fetch the one you need: `part` gives that part’s fields from the schema, who acts at play time and its nested shapes; a topic (writing, cheating, asks, cannot) gives how to write a spec, designing against bots, asks that look impossible, or what loot cannot do with the nearest versions.

part.description: One part, with its fields and nested shapes, or one topic (writing, cheating, asks, cannot).
